url.description: The URL exactly as the sitemap wrote it.

normalizedUrl.description: The same URL after normalization: fragment removed, percent-escapes and host case folded, default port dropped. Used for de-duplication. http and https, and www and the apex host, are kept distinct because they often serve different content.

sourceSitemap.description: Which sitemap file this URL was found in.

depth.description: How many sitemap-index hops deep the source sitemap was. 0 means it came from the seed sitemap itself.

checked.description: True when a status probe actually produced a status code.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code from the probe. Null when the URL was not checked or the probe failed before a status arrived.

contentType.description: The response Content-Type from the probe, if any.

lastmodRaw.description: The <lastmod> value verbatim, whatever shape it had (YYYY, YYYY-MM, RFC822, +0800 without a colon, impossible dates). Kept because a parseable rewrite loses information.

lastmodIso.description: The same value best-effort-parsed to ISO-8601. Null when it could not be parsed — the row is never dropped for a bad date.

changeFrequency.description: The sitemap <changefreq>, if present. Reported, not obeyed.

hasImages.description: The sitemap entry carried image extensions.

hasNews.description: The sitemap entry carried Google News extensions.

alternateCount.description: How many hreflang / xhtml:link alternates the entry listed.

crossDomain.description: True when the URL's host is not the site you asked for. Such rows are listed but never requested.

errorType.description: Why this row is not a plain success. One of a fixed enum so failures can be filtered and counted — free-text errors cannot.

errorMessage.description: Human-readable detail for errorType. Filter on errorType; read errorMessage.

overview.title: URLs and status
overview.description: One row per URL the site publishes, with the status code that came back.

source.title: Where each URL came from
source.description: Provenance and sitemap metadata: which sitemap listed it, how deep, and what the entry carried.

problems.title: Anything that did not come back clean
problems.description: Read this first. Every row here has an errorType — filter on it rather than on the message.
